name: blockbench-mcp
description: Minecraft-oriented BlockBench MCP — pure desktop plugin (in-process HTTP MCP)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @blockbench-mcp/shared && npm run build -w @blockbench-mcp/plugin
scripts.build:legacy-adapter: npm run build -w @blockbench-mcp/shared && npm run build -w @blockbench-mcp/adapter
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blockbench-mcp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @blockbench-mcp/plugin
